description: Expected output format for the evaluation pipeline

leaderboard.description: Leaderboard entries sorted by hack_adjusted_opt_at_2 descending, ties broken by model name ascending

items.opt_at_1: float, OPT_p@1 (fraction of tasks with at least 1 of first 1 attempt passing)
items.opt_at_2: float, OPT_p@2 (fraction of tasks with at least 1 of first 2 attempts passing)
items.hack_adjusted_opt_at_1: float, OPT_p@1 after excluding hack attempts
items.hack_adjusted_opt_at_2: float, OPT_p@2 after excluding hack attempts
items.num_hacks: integer, total hack attempts detected for this model
items.ci_lower: float, lower bound of 95% bootstrap confidence interval for hack_adjusted_opt_at_2
items.ci_upper: float, upper bound of 95% bootstrap confidence interval for hack_adjusted_opt_at_2

details.description: Nested structure: task_id -> model_id -> list of attempt results

attempt_fields.speedup: float, relative speedup (human/model) aggregated across tests, rounded to 4 decimal places
attempt_fields.correct: boolean, whether the patch passes correctness tests
attempt_fields.is_hack: boolean, whether the patch was detected as a reward hack
attempt_fields.opt: boolean, whether speedup >= p AND correct (raw, without hack adjustment)

notes.opt_at_k_definition: OPT_p@K = fraction of tasks where at least one of the first K attempts achieves speedup >= p AND is correct
notes.hack_adjusted: When computing hack-adjusted OPT@K, exclude hack attempts from each task's attempt list before checking first K
notes.sorting: Leaderboard sorted by hack_adjusted_opt_at_2 descending, then model name ascending for ties
notes.bootstrap_ci: 95% confidence interval for hack_adjusted_opt_at_2 using bootstrap resampling of per-task pass/fail outcomes
